parts.note_add: S-001 p30: the front harness meets the engine harness at X-01, the in-panel harness at X-02 and X-12, and the rear harness at X-03; body grounds are X-13 (LH suspension tower and under the dash LH), X-14 and X-15. Wire colours are base then tracer (GY = green/yellow; Lg = light green).
The catalogue figure (S-005 1800A-1, item 18590) draws the bracket carrying a two-unit plug-in block; no source read names the circuit - confirm on the car.

Normally-open 3-wire relay: GW (15 A fuse, shared with stop lamps) feeds coil and contact, the horn button grounds the coil through GL, the contact sends GY to both horns (S-001 p22). The catalogue figure 6630A-1 and the 1985 manual (p15-11) put it under the dash LH beside the CPU, not in the engine bay as the horn write-up says - confirm.

Two change-over contact sets and a diode-protected coil (S-001 p24): at rest LR feeds R and LY is grounded (mast down); with the coil grounded through LG by the radio or antenna switch, LR feeds L and R is grounded (mast up). Read from a coarse scan and checked against the 1985 manual's motor test - confirm.

Mazda Warehouse sells 1480-67-740 as the Hot Start Relay ('3 Point Relay'), and the catalogue figure puts it in the LH engine bay beside the choke & check relay, where the 1985 manual (p15-11) puts the 12A hot start relay: so this is most likely S-001's A-03 hot start relay - confirm on the car.

S-001 p30 (X-04) shows 15 fuses on four feeds: WR battery, L accessory, BY ignition and BW ignition. OEM-RECORD's bus map reads two positions differently: it shows a 7.5 A BW alternator fuse, where S-001 p10/p14 show BW coming off a 15 A fuse from BY (IG) to the alternator, coils and emission parts, and Br off a 10 A (IG) fuse to cruise control.
Fuse body style (glass cartridge or flat Japanese type) was not found in any source; read it off the block before buying - confirm.
The two brown 0.3 sq links sit either side of the black main link in the battery-side block X-07. One feeds the headlight retractor (WR), the other the headlights (WG) (S-001 p30).
The black 1.25 sq main link carries battery + to the WR constant bus that feeds the ignition switch and fuse block (S-001 p10, p30).
